rv.q: This summer season opener feels perfectly in tune with its audience: a sheer crowd-pleaser packed with no little energy, effort and perfectly synchronised joie de vivre.
The masterstroke of Sam Hardie’s production for the Pitlochry Festival Theatre’s summer season is to lean into that nostalgia and make it a core part of the audience experience.
This production is a triumph, proving that over 50 years since it first premiered, Grease continues to find relevance for a contemporary audience.

cn.t: Critics praise this joyful, nostalgia-filled production that captures the beloved musical's 1950s charm with an impressive 17-strong ensemble of actor-musicians, delivering crowd-pleasing fun that leaves audiences smiling.
